segments.en: On day 9, Alex has a small task. Alex has practised the basics, so the team gives Alex a small task. First, Alex checks "CPU" and "processor" and writes one clear note about the work. During a short chat, Maria uses "take out the trash" and "do the laundry". Alex answers politely and asks one question. Then Alex records the progress with "merge branches" and "merge conflict" so the team can follow the change. The task is not big, but Alex can now explain it from start to finish.
